ruleDefinitions.name: Import PowerShell Modules From Suspicious Directories
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects powershell scripts that import modules from suspicious directories Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ \\"\\$Env\\:Temp\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ \\'\\$Env\\:Temp\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ \\$Env\\:Temp\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ \\"\\$Env\\:Appdata\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ \\'\\$Env\\:Appdata\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ \\$Env\\:Appdata\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ipmo\\ \\"\\$Env\\:Temp\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ipmo\\ \\'\\$Env\\:Temp\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ipmo\\ \\$Env\\:Temp\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ipmo\\ \\"\\$Env\\:Appdata\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ipmo\\ \\'\\$Env\\:Appdata\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ipmo\\ \\$Env\\:Appdata\\\\.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ipmo\\ C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*"))
